title: Impl: Python silent observer tracking in neighbor table
description: Add three fields to neighbor tracking in Python: app_packets_seen (int, incremented in node._process_received when packet is non-routing), vouch_count (int, from web-of-trust if implemented, else 0), first_seen_ts (float, set on first DIO/announce). Add property is_silent_observer that evaluates the heuristic. Add to neighbor status output. Files: python/src/lichen/node.py or neighbor tracking module. Verify: cd python && python -m pytest tests/test_node*.py -x
